# 36氪 (36Kr)

> > Leading Chinese technology and business media platform covering startups, innovation, and industry trends across sectors including automotive, carbon, consumer, enterprise services, and emerging technologies.

36氪 is China's premier tech media outlet featuring specialized verticals like 36氪Auto, 36氪出海 (overseas), 36氪研究院 (research institute), 数字时氪 (digital era), and 未来消费 (future consumption). The platform provides comprehensive news coverage, live streaming events, industry analysis, and investment intelligence for entrepreneurs, investors, and business professionals.

## Key Topics

- 36氪 - Core brand and platform
- 36氪Auto - Automotive sector coverage
- 数字时氪 - Digital transformation insights
- 未来消费 - Future consumption trends
- 智能涌现 - Emerging intelligence/AI
- 未来城市 - Future cities and urban innovation
- 36氪出海 - International expansion coverage
- 36氪研究院 - Research institute
- 36氪企服点评 - Enterprise services reviews
- 36氪财经 - Financial news
- 36碳 - Carbon and sustainability
- 潮生TIDE - Trend analysis
- Startup ecosystem and venture capital
- Chinese tech industry analysis
- Business intelligence and market research
